module Knowledge
  class PublishDelivery
    def call(delivery_id:, store:)
      delivery = Delivery.find(delivery_id)
      payload = JSON.parse(delivery.payload)
      begin
        store.publish(id: delivery.event_id, type: 'DocumentPublished', data: payload)

steps.message: The current job has the key flaw: it falls back to the original snapshot when the locked recheck fails, so deletion/withdrawal/tenant changes still produce an embedding. I’ll replace that with an explicit discard path, keep provider invocation entirely outside the transaction, and serialize the authoritative document plus target embedding row while conditionally preserving a higher-revision existing embedding. I’ll also add tests for initial unavailability, mutation during provider execution, provider errors, version coexistence, and protection against an older result overwriting a newer one.

# frozen_string_literal: true

module Knowledge
  class EmbeddingJob
    def call(document_id:, tenant_id:, version:, provider:)
      snapshot = Document.find_by(id: document_id, tenant_id: tenant_id, published: true)
      return :discarded unless snapshot

      # The provider may be slow (and may perform arbitrary application work), so
      # it must never run while holding a database transaction.
      vector = provider.call(snapshot.body)

      result = :discarded
      Document.transaction do
        # Lock the authoritative row and match the complete snapshot.  In
        # particular, do not use the snapshot as a fallback: it may have been
        # withdrawn, deleted, reassigned, or revised while the provider ran.
        current = Document.lock.find_by(id: document_id, tenant_id: tenant_id,
                                        published: true, revision: snapshot.revision)
        next unless current

        embedding = Embedding.lock.find_by(document_id: current.id, version: version)
        # A later job may have already written a newer revision for this
        # document/version.  An older provider response must not replace it.
        unless embedding && embedding.revision > current.revision
          attributes = { document_id: current.id, tenant_id: current.tenant_id,
                         revision: current.revision, version: version,
                         vector: JSON.generate(vector) }
          if embedding
            embedding.update!(attributes)
          else
            Embedding.create!(attributes)
          end
        end
        result = :stored
      end

      result
    end
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

require_relative 'test_helper'

class EmbeddingJobTest < BenchmarkTest
  def job(document, version: 'v1', provider:)
    Knowledge::EmbeddingJob.new.call(document_id: document.id, tenant_id: document.tenant_id,
                                     version: version, provider: provider)
  end

  def test_unavailable_document_is_discarded_without_calling_provider
    missing_id = 999_999
    called = false

    result = Knowledge::EmbeddingJob.new.call(document_id: missing_id, tenant_id: 'a', version: 'v1',
                                              provider: ->(_) { called = true })

    assert_equal :discarded, result
    refute called
    assert_empty Knowledge::Embedding.all
  end

  def test_revision_change_during_provider_call_discards_result
    expected = document
    result = job(expected, provider: lambda { |_body|
      expected.update!(revision: expected.revision + 1)
      [1.0]
    })

    assert_equal :discarded, result
    assert_empty Knowledge::Embedding.all
  end

  def test_withdrawal_during_provider_call_discards_result
    expected = document
    result = job(expected, provider: lambda { |_body|
      expected.update!(published: false)
      [1.0]
    })

    assert_equal :discarded, result
    assert_empty Knowledge::Embedding.all
  end

  def test_tenant_reassignment_during_provider_call_discards_result
    expected = document
    result = job(expected, provider: lambda { |_body|
      expected.update!(tenant_id: 'b')
      [1.0]
    })

    assert_equal :discarded, result
    assert_empty Knowledge::Embedding.all
  end

  def test_provider_error_propagates_without_writing
    expected = document
    error = Class.new(StandardError)

    assert_raises(error) do
      job(expected, provider: ->(_) { raise error, 'provider failed' })
    end
    assert_empty Knowledge::Embedding.all
  end

  def test_embedding_versions_coexist
    expected = document
    assert_equal :stored, job(expected, version: 'v1', provider: ->(_) { [1.0] })
    assert_equal :stored, job(expected, version: 'v2', provider: ->(_) { [2.0] })

    assert_equal %w[v1 v2], Knowledge::Embedding.order(:version).pluck(:version)
  end

  def test_older_result_does_not_overwrite_newer_embedding
    expected = document
    Knowledge::Embedding.create!(document_id: expected.id, tenant_id: 'a', revision: 2,
                                 version: 'v1', vector: JSON.generate([2.0]))

    result = job(expected, provider: ->(_) { [1.0] })

    assert_equal :stored, result
    embedding = Knowledge::Embedding.find_by!(document_id: expected.id, version: 'v1')
    assert_equal 2, embedding.revision
    assert_equal [2.0], JSON.parse(embedding.vector)
  end
end
